blacklistabilityReview.sourceFreeRationale: The current holder-facing CADm token has no direct governance-controlled blacklist, freeze, pause, seizure, arbitrary-account burn, or transfer-hook restriction. Broker/exchange burn and Celo-VM gas debiting are protocol-scoped, not governance holder-freeze controls. Timelocked proxy upgrade authority is recorded in mint-authority evidence but is not itself a currently executable holder-freeze surface. This direct conclusion does not suppress reserve-derived upstream exposure.
blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Celo is the sole tracked deployment and holds 100% of CADm circulating supply in the 2026-10-19 census. At Celo block 80489715 (2026-10-19T06:14:33Z), proxy 0xff4ab19391af240c311c54200a492233052b6325 returned _getImplementation()=0x434563b0604be100f04b7ae485bcafe3c9d8850e, owner()=_getOwner()=0x890db8a597940165901372dd7db61c9f246e2147, broker()=0x777a8255ca72412f0d706dc03c9d1987306b4cad, validators()=0xaeb865bca93ddc8f47b8e29f40c5399ce34d0c58 and exchange()=zero. Verified StableTokenV2 implements ordinary transfer/transferFrom, permissioned mint, onlyBurner burn(uint256) that burns msg.sender only, and Celo-VM-only debitGasFees; it has no blacklist, freeze, global pause, allowlist, arbitrary-account burn or restrictive transfer hook. Nevertheless, the verified proxy's onlyOwner _setImplementation(address) can replace the holder-facing token implementation. Its current owner is the live Mento Timelock: getMinDelay()=172800 seconds, Governor 0x47036d78bb3169b4f5560dd77bf93f4412a59852 has PROPOSER_ROLE, execution is open to address zero, and Governor.timelock() returns 0x890db8a597940165901372dd7db61c9f246e2147. DAO/community governance and a two-day delay do not exempt a direct upgradeable stablecoin under the exposure policy. Therefore direct Possible supersedes the stored Upstream verdict. No variantOf or mint-authority inheritedFrom parent is declared. Official Mento configuration identifies shared reserve backing, including USDC, USDT, EURC and other issuer/custodian-controlled assets; those remain separate reserve censorship risks, not a reason to downgrade a direct Possible to Upstream. No current direct individual-holder freeze is asserted.

oracleRisk.summary: At Celo block 78986505, CADm's Broker/BiPoolManager USDm/CADm ConstantSum exchange 0x517ccc3bcab9f35e2e24143a0c1809068efc649f740846cfb6a1c5703735c1ee uses CAD/USD feed 0x20869cf54ead821c45dfb2ab0c23d2e10fbb65a4, one ChainlinkRelayerV1 reporter 0x3a7af4e6f53ac13bc9e67cb6ed5866d855692390, and one configured Chainlink aggregator 0x2f6d6cb9e01d63e1a1873bacc5bfd4e7d4e461d1. getRates and medianRate agree on 703022290000000000000000/1e24; medianTimestamp is 1790887026. Effective report expiry and bucket reset are 360 seconds, minimumReports is 1, and spread is 0.15%. MedianDeltaBreaker is enabled at 4% with a 900-second reset cooldown; ValueDeltaBreaker is disabled. The sorted-list median of one relayer is not independent medianization or failover. Stale reports invalidate ConstantSum quotes; BreakerBox suspends execution rather than substituting a second source. This evidenced single-live-source topology retains the existing Mento single-source-or-laggy convention; it does not assert the pinned report was stale.

branchApplicability.rationale: CADm is explicitly reserve-backed in the pinned issuer configuration, not one of the GBPm/CHFm/JPYm CDP assets. The enumerated pinned Broker mint/burn exchange has external price authority but no borrower-specific liquidation engine. Score this authority as coin-price-feed/top-level-only; branch rows and liquidationDelaySec are not applicable. A 900-second breaker reset cooldown or 360-second report expiry is not a liquidation delay. This review covers canonical Celo exchange pricing and does not classify separate bridge control or remote-chain liquidity.
